notes.title: Hard Time III
notes.notes:
Thanks to everybody who supported this little 2D revival, Hard Time is back to serve its 3rd consecutive sentence!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3009850/Hard_Time_III/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30190750/96e18a63d037f4bb84a606bcb29600b53f9e05f6.jpg[/img]

It combines classic moments from the OG with the best aspects of 2D, while putting out a few hits of its own. Hunt it down now while you can still benefit from the 20% launch discount...

notes.title: Multiplayer Multiplier
notes.notes:
While adapting the game for Steam Deck, I also managed to fine-tune the desktop experience. You should find it can now recognize multiple controllers instead of just one, and even does a better job of mapping modern ones like Xbox Series X and Playstation 5 before you resort to calibration. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30190750/3c20d0ebc8378f20fa0ee25e7d0e18bb729f540d.jpg[/img]

There's also a new twist on how you use spare controllers once they're connected. Inspired by the recent You Testament release, the "Mystery" multiplayer option deliberately hides the controller icons to create an "Among Us" style mystery about who your fellow humans are controlling!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2266320/The_You_Testament_The_2D_Coming/

notes.title: Cell Dimensions
notes.notes:
Although the game bumbled its way to being "Playable" on Steam Deck as it was, this is the 1st time I've updated it after seeing it with my own eyes. It now makes better use of the 1280x800 resolution by targeting it as standard, resulting in the sharpest display these old games have ever been able to enjoy! Be sure to switch the resolution options to "High" if you haven't yet given it a try.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30190750/8920284406faf16fbbfdcc51e1e488ecc38d15e2.jpg[/img]

I also fixed whatever was preventing the D-Pad from being acknowledged if you prefer that to thumbstick movement.

I see the Steam Deck as a safe haven for my old games to remain accessible for many more years to come, so I hope to add more of them if the demand is there...

notes.title: Cops & Robbers
notes.notes:
Multiplayer isn't quite as good a fit for the adventure games, but it will at least be possible for other controllers to help or hinder the star player. In this context, "Versus" casts your friends as wardens whereas "Co-Op" casts them as fellow inmates.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30190750/ee0d62d473158dbd69d9a8aaae38a91fcda223b9.jpg[/img]
